protocol.selected_heads: Unchanged ranked eight pre-o_proj query heads from frozen scanner; concatenate in selected rank order.
protocol.inference: One sequential frozen nativeMXFP4 forward per batch on exactly four A40s. No residual/local-attention legacy capture.
protocol.hooks: Prehooks return None. Compare final hidden states bitwise with writes disabled, proving no bank writes during self-check.
protocol.portability: Same saved F16 vectors through NumPy and GPU float64 frozen per-head LDA probabilities; max absolute difference <=5e-5.
protocol.restart: Atomic NaN initialization, byte-copied row table, fsynced exact prompt-prefix checkpoints and independent committed-batch SHA checks.

protocol.source: Existing frozen systemness_natural_transcripts dev320 prepared cache, not public-source replay.
protocol.filter: All255 prepared fit conversations with eligible_fit=True plus all64 validation conversations; quarantine the entire one contaminated fit conversation including all320 of its body rows. No validation enters fit.
protocol.row_identity: Stable original prompt/sample order. Preserve original4e12 sample_ix with quarantine gap; new contiguous cache_ix/prompt_ix and original_cache_ix/original_prompt_ix. Never synthesize C4 line/document IDs.
protocol.selected_head_order: Identical original frozen top8 order; pre-o_proj query heads.
protocol.identity: Fixed original joint-mlp128 SHA27a22 only as portable parity consumer; metadata/config/tokenizer/verified weights closure. No current seed/augmentation results or old rglob verifier.
protocol.backend: Exactly4 A40; frozen nativeMXFP4 sequential shared forward; transient current-batch selected-head vectors only.
protocol.batch_order: Prioritize prompts containing fixed first256 clean FIT cache_ix, then remaining prompts by(length,prompt_ix). First batch covers the fixed FIT parity targets. Never compute validation classifier probabilities during extraction.
protocol.hook_check: Capture disabled: no features allocated or written; final hidden states bitexact before/after prehook registration. Hooks return None.
protocol.parity: Only fixed first256 clean FIT cache_ix: save exact bank F16 vectors, sample_ix and CPU/GPU original portable probabilities; maxabs<5e-4. No validation model probability is computed. Numerical parity, not evaluation or selection.
protocol.restart: Atomic NaN bank initialization and exact selected-row owner. Every committed batch has byteSHA, target/sample/prompt prefix hashes. Partial uncommitted rows are recomputed; initialized missing/truncated bank fails. Completion read-only.

old.transition_definition: Rows index original base p.argmax; columns index residual p.argmax, regardless of ground-truth role. CoT_to_assistant is a newly introduced winner transition, not total truth-CoT misclassification.
old.metric_convention: Unmodified savedF32 p.argmax; raw-tail bitidentity does not guarantee p rounding preserves non-system argmax.
